direction: Instrumental anime space-shooter soundtrack. Analog synths, shimmering arpeggios, punchy electronic drums, warm bass. Clear memorable melodies, futuristic heroic atmosphere, no vocals.

tracks.role: Launch bay, anticipation before deploying into space
Early fleet battles, agile flight and resonant chain explosions
Late battles through hostile nebulae, escalating enemy swarms
Final battle against a colossal mechanical reactor fortress
Fleet defeated, triumphant return and results screen
Ship lost, reflective results screen inviting another sortie
Percussion-only overlay for early battle Overdrive
